**Basic Rates**  
- Daily rate (DR) = ₱720.00  
- Hourly rate (HR) = DR ÷ 8 = ₱90.00

- Rest day / Special non-working day (first 8 hrs): 130% × DR = ₱936.00/day → hourly = ₱117.00  
  OT on these days: ₱117.00 × 1.30 = ₱152.10/hr (169% of HR)  
- Regular holiday (first 8 hrs): 200% × DR = ₱1,440.00/day → hourly = ₱180.00

| Wed | Special non-working (unworked) | 0 | No policy/CBA → no pay | ₱0.00 |
| Thu | Regular holiday (unworked) | 0 | 100% DR (qualified: worked preceding workday Tue) | ₱720.00 |
| Fri | Absent without pay | 0 | No pay | ₱0.00 |
| Sat | Ordinary | 8 hrs | 8 × ₱90.00 | ₱720.00 |
| Sun | Rest day (worked) | 10 hrs (8 reg + 2 OT) | Reg: 8×117 = 936; OT: 2×152.10 = 304.20; NSD (10pm–12am): 2×9 = 18 | ₱1,258.20 |
| **Week 2** | | | | |
| Mon | Regular holiday (worked) | 8 hrs | 200% DR = 1,440; NSD (10pm–11pm): 1×9 = 9 | ₱1,449.00 |
| Tue | Ordinary | 8 hrs | 8 × ₱90.00 | ₱720.00 |
| Wed | Ordinary | 8 hrs | 8 × ₱90.00 | ₱720.00 |
| Thu | Ordinary | 10 hrs (8 reg + 2 OT) | Reg: 720; OT: 2×112.50 = 225; NSD (10pm–12am): 2×9 = 18 | ₱963.00 |
| Fri | Ordinary | 8 hrs | 8 × ₱90.00 | ₱720.00 |
| Sat | Special non-working (worked) | 10 hrs (8 reg + 2 OT) | Reg: 130% DR = 936; OT: 2×152.10 = 304.20 | ₱1,240.20 |
| Sun | Rest day (unworked) | 0 | No pay | ₱0.00 |

**Sum of Daily Pays**  
Week 1: 720.00 + 945.00 + 0.00 + 720.00 + 0.00 + 720.00 + 1,258.20 = **₱4,363.20**  
Week 2: 1,449.00 + 720.00 + 720.00 + 963.00 + 720.00 + 1,240.20 + 0.00 = **₱5,812.20**  

**Total Pay** = ₱4,363.20 + ₱5,812.20 = **₱10,175.40**
